scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @cliproam/protocol build && cross-env CLIPROAM_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin node --import tsx --watch src/index.ts
scripts.build: shx rm -rf build dist admin && pnpm --filter @cliproam/protocol build && pnpm --filter @cliproam/admin build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && shx cp -r admin build/admin && pnpm --config.node-linker=hoisted --config.package-import-method=copy --filter @cliproam/server deploy --prod --legacy dist
